skill_friction: Section 7 guidance says 'use Flow Tests or manual checks, not Apex tests' for flow-only changes, then allows an Apex DML test when it 'exercises the flow better'; for a cross-object outcome (assert on other records) it is not stated that a Flow Test cannot assert it, so whether to add an Apex test class row (vs. Rule 4 'speculative components') required judgment.

R timed out and the narrowed retry covered only runtime; the table's 'cover the parts a narrowed retry left out with another narrow call or org queries' does not say whether a second narrow call (security half) counts toward retries; I covered it with a FieldPermissions query instead.

Rule 3's 'after two wrong AskCoworker claims, verify every fact' mostly concerned platform-behavior claims (DML per interview, merge SetNull) that no allowed query can test; the skill does not say how to handle that trigger when the wrong claims are untestable platform behavior.

Seq numbering interleaving: the protocol wants a single seq across AskCoworker calls and org queries, but batched parallel Bash queries make one 'org query' entry cover many queries; granularity is unspecified.
